name: 托马斯·亨特·摩尔根
bio_short: 美国遗传学家和胚胎学家，1933年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖得主。他利用果蝇进行研究，确立了“染色体遗传理论”（`morgan_fruit_fly_1910`），证明了基因位于染色体上，是现代遗传学的奠基人之一。
bio_short_en: An American geneticist and embryologist, and a 1933 Nobel laureate. Through his research on fruit flies, he established the 'Chromosome Theory of Inheritance' (`morgan_fruit_fly_1910`), proving that genes are located on chromosomes, making him one of the fathers of modern genetics.
